Devon (Sales Eng): Kicking off a scoped thread for AcmeBank POC — goal is to map 3 customer journeys, define endpoints, success metrics, ask security/pricing Qs, and confirm timeline. Quick sync notes below.
Maria (Solutions): thanks. high-level ask from ACME: smart customer support + transaction summarization + intent routing. they want low-latency for chat and nightly batch embeddings.
Alex (AE): customer goal = reduce support handle time by 30% and automate reconciliation summaries for ops. budget: they asked for a pricing anchor before EOW.
Sam (Customer PM): can confirm journeys: 1) customer chat (webwidget), 2) back-office reconciliation reports, 3) fraud flagging alert summaries. priority order: chat > reports > alerts.
Devon (Sales Eng): good. endpoints we need to surface: `/v1/generate/chat` (streaming), `/v1/embeddings/batch` (nightly), `/v1/rerank/transactions` (realtime). Need SLO targets per endpoint.
Maria (Solutions): propose SLOs: chat p95 latency < 350ms, embedding job SLAs nightly complete by 3am UTC, rerank p95 < 450ms. is that reasonable? :thinking_face:
Priya (Security): initial security checklist: SOC2 type II evidence, data residency (EU for some customers), KMS integration, PII minimization, retention policy. also need threat model for banking data.
Sam (Customer PM): confirms EU residency requirement for 2 of their regions. They also need audit logs for every prompt/response for 90 days.
Devon (Sales Eng): action: Priya - can you flag any redlines that would block Private deployment? Alex - share committed usage estimate so we can price reserved vs hosted.
Priya (Security): redlines: can't accept unencrypted persistent KV cache for PII, must be able to run private control plane or dedicated capacity. Need answers on HSM support for keys.
Maria (Solutions): on evals: we'll run prompt-based regressions. Request from customer: accuracy for entity extraction >= 92% on their labeled set; summarization F1 >= 0.78. We'll need a test harness and sample prompt set.
Devon (Sales Eng): can we get sample data? Sam, can Acme share 200 labeled chat examples + 500 transactions for rerank?
Sam (Customer PM): yes — will get a sanitized batch by Thurs. note: some examples include account numbers; we'll sanitize but may need partial redaction guidance.
Alex (AE): budget note: customer expects a committed monthly spend if latency/SLA met. ballpark usage: 3M chat tokens/month, 50k embedding vectors/night, ~800k rerank calls/month.
Maria (Solutions): quick cost check: if hosted per-token -> estimate ~$X/month; dedicated reserved -> provide delta after usage commit. Devon/Finance, please compute cost-vs-commit options.
Devon (Sales Eng): will run numbers. Also run a small perf run to validate 350ms p95. Maria - can you spin up a test harness on our sandbox?
Maria (Solutions): yes. I'll create a canary config: model=redwood-2-small (quantized), batch_size tuning, prefix caching enabled. I'll post config snippet.
ci-bot: Deploy started: sandbox/poc-acme/tests at 1718301200 — job #8421
Maria (Solutions): config (partial):
```
endpoint: /v1/generate/chat
model: redwood-2-small-q4
stream: true
batching: dynamic
max_tokens: 1024
```
Devon (Sales Eng): nice. For success criteria doc let's capture minimal pass/fail: chat latency + summary quality + rerank precision. Proposed acceptance:
- Chat: p95 < 350ms and successful stream reconnects < 0.5%
- Summaries: ROUGE-L > 0.55 and customer-labeled F1 >= 0.78
- Rerank: NDCG@10 uplift >= 12% vs baseline
- Ops: nightly embedding job success rate 99.5%
Priya (Security): add security acceptance: encryption at rest & in transit, per-customer key support, audit log availability, SSO (SAML) for console access.
Sam (Customer PM): timeline: week1 get data + eval harness, week2 run functional tests, week3 perf + security review, week4 final acceptance + contract signature. Customer expects demo end of week3.
Alex (AE): sounds good. I need to confirm procurement timeline — could delay contract signature. Let's keep contingency.
Devon (Sales Eng): blockers identified: 1) private control plane request might add 2-4 weeks, 2) HSM/KMS certs need security signoff, 3) embedding throughput tuning for nightly window.
Maria (Solutions): mitigation: can propose hybrid: dedicated GPUs in our hosted region with EU tenancy for early tests while we provision Private. reduces blocker risk.
Priya (Security): we'll need a short questionnaire reply for their InfoSec team. I'll draft answers for SOC2, encryption, certs, and retention. Can someone attach our compliance pack?
Devon (Sales Eng): I'll attach the standard compliance pack to the thread and ping legal for HSM doc.
Maria (Solutions): immediate action items: 1) Sam -> provide sanitized data by Thu, 2) Priya -> draft security Q answers by Tue, 3) Devon -> send pricing anchors and reserved vs hosted numbers by Tue EOD, 4) Maria -> spin up sandbox and share test harness link.
Sam (Customer PM): ack. targeting Thu.
Alex (AE): I'll nudge procurement.
ci-bot: Job #8421 succeeded at 1718301405
Maria (Solutions): created test harness: https://sandbox.redwood.internal/poc-acme/test-harness (internal) — contains prompt templates + `evals/` set.
Devon (Sales Eng): thanks — I'll schedule a 30-min sync with Acme on Mon to walk through the acceptance checklist. Anyone want to join?
Priya (Security): I'll join the Mon call for the security section.
Alex (AE): can join for procurement questions.
Maria (Solutions): will join for demo run-through.
Devon (Sales Eng): great. Keeping thread updated with artifacts. :rocket:
